arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Convert the supplied original pixel sprite into a polished hand-drawn cartoon game asset. The reference is authoritative for subject, orientation and arrangement, not pixel texture. A wide white cloud-shaped thought bubble with black scalloped outline, containing one large golden-yellow round pocket watch tilted just slightly, with small winding knob/loop at top. White watch face, black Arabic numerals 1 through 12 once each in correct clockwise order, black hour hand pointing to 3 and minute hand straight to12, small center pin. Preserve source watch proportions and white cloud boundary, no face, no eyes, no arms or anthropomorphism. Transparent outside bubble, no speech tail or trailing bubble dots. Crisp dark outlines, clean smooth cel shading with gentle highlights, bright classic cartoon palette consistent with the ongoing game art. Keep all subject content comfortably inside the output canvas. Do not copy pixel stair-steps. No watermark, no extra writing except the specifically requested source lettering. Genuine RGBA transparency wherever the original is transparent. Single drawing only.
